Theseinfluences arewhatcause splittingof thepeaks(sometimes referred to as spin-spin coupling), usually considered in terms of the n+1 rule. Very simply, if a carbon atom has n protons, then thepeaksonadjacentcarbonatoms aresplitinton+1sub-peaks The split peaks are sometimes referred to as multiplets,but more often by a term indicating the number of sub-peaks.

items.label: text
items.text: If the peak is not split, it is called a singlet.

items.label: text
items.text: If the peak is split into two sub-peaks, it is called a doublet.

items.label: text
items.text: If the peak is split into three sub-peaks, it is called a triplet.

items.label: text
items.text: If the peak is split into four sub-peaks, it is called a quartet.
